title: addin.tools 0.0.11
text: Migrated runtime pipelines package code magrittr %>% native R pipe |>. Removed stale %>% import annotations cleaned dependency metadata drop unused magrittr Imports. Kept %>% references user-facing documentation contexts operator discussed inserted text. Validated migration safety package-local tests clean maintainer R CMD check run. Updated GitHub Actions workflows replace deprecated actions/checkout@v3 actions/upload-artifact@v3 @v4 variants. Fixed lint workflow failures correcting .lintr configuration format using current styler dry-run API CI. Fixed package documentation use "_PACKAGE" instead deprecated roxygen @docType package. Fixed is_blank_line_needed_below() argument matching "first row" "last row" call sites. Improved package-check readiness excluding prompt/planning artifacts package build inputs via .Rbuildignore. Updated LICENSE stub valid DCF format MIT + file LICENSE metadata. Added explicit global variable declarations used tidy-eval pipelines avoid R CMD check NSE notes. Expanded unit tests substantially core helpers (selection/index/row/text/blank-line behavior). Added dedicated regression tests %>% pipeline behavior, including select_correct_range() output selection side effects, support safe future migration %>% |>. Consolidated duplicate index helper definitions R/rs_get_index.R single implementations removed superseded suffixed variants preserving first/last/selection behavior. Modernized package baselines DESCRIPTION (R (>= 4.1), testthat (>= 3.0.0), Config/testthat/edition: 3) moved rstudioapi Imports. Confirmed GitHub Actions sole active CI path removed Travis maintenance remnants. Refreshed README wording install guidance, removed stale date badge, updated logo source branch links README.Rmd README.md. Added lightweight lint configuration via .lintr set styler addin default transformer strict = FALSE .Rprofile. Renamed visual-editor helper is_visual_editor() documented is_rmd_visual_mode backward-compatible alias. Added CRAN submission checklist downstream deprecation migration guidance .github/.
